premise.claim: GenerateNodeAffinity in pkg/dataflow/helper.go iterates the job annotations map with 'for key, value := range annotations', so multiple injected affinity annotations yield non-deterministic MatchExpressions ordering on the generated affinity (issue #6238).
premise.evidence: Contract test grafted unchanged onto base 5e647359 FAILS at iteration 0 with unsorted output [zone region hostname rack a-first]; the prefix-collision control passes on base, so the red is not a harness artifact. See results/unit-base-harness.txt.

findings.note: Core acceptance: MatchExpressions are exactly the customized-affinity annotations, in sorted key order, on every call.
Slash-form scope annotations (affinity.dataflow.fluid.io/inject|labels) must never leak into MatchExpressions. Passes on base and head (pre-existing correct behavior, kept as regression guard).
The PR's own new determinism test plus the strengthened strict-DeepEqual table test.
Fake-client status-handler suites of both GenerateNodeAffinity callers (dataload, datamigrate) stay green: 45/45 + full datamigrate suite.

liveNote: L3 skipped per round instructions (no KUBECONFIG layer). The change only reorders ANDed NodeSelectorRequirements inside one NodeSelectorTerm, which the kube-scheduler treats order-insensitively; there is no live-only signal to observe beyond a real dataflow run producing a stable, sorted OperationStatus.NodeAffinity.
